BROWNIE A LA MODE

NOOK · VOCO Surf SideDe La Mora Zumarán · Kitchen Support
INGREDIENTS
INGREDIENTQTYUNIT
INGREDIENTS
Cake / pastry flour (9–10% protein)150g
Cocoa powder (Dutch-processed)50g
Dark chocolate (65–70% cocoa)250g
Unsalted butter200g
Whole eggs (room temperature)250g
White granulated sugar300g
Brown / Muscovado sugar100g
Pure vanilla extract10g
Fine salt5g
1 × 30×20 cm pan · approx. 15–18 portions · 45–50 min process
PROCEDURE
1FAT MELTING
Melt chocolate and butter together over a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second intervals. Do not exceed 45–50°C to prevent cocoa butter separation. Cool to 35°C before proceeding.
2EGG & SUGAR EMULSION
Using the whisk attachment, beat whole eggs, both sugars, and vanilla on medium-high speed for 5–7 minutes until the mixture reaches the ribbon stage: pale, aerated, and tripled in volume. This step is required to develop the signature crinkled top crust.
3CHOCOLATE INTEGRATION
Reduce mixer to minimum speed. Add the cooled chocolate-butter mixture in a steady stream and mix until fully homogenized.
4DRY INGREDIENT INCORPORATION
Sift flour, cocoa powder, and salt together. Fold into the emulsion using a spatula. Stop immediately once no dry flour traces remain. Overmixing develops gluten and results in a rubbery texture.
5PANNING
Pour batter into a parchment-lined 30×20 cm pan. Level the surface with an offset spatula.
6BAKING
Preheat oven to 175°C (160°C for pure convection). Bake 25–30 minutes with vent closed. Optimal doneness: top crust is formed; a tester inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs — never clean, which indicates overbaking.
7COOLING AND PORTIONING
Cool completely in the pan at room temperature. For clean, standardized cuts, refrigerate covered for at minimum 2 hours before portioning.

SR-01SUB-RECIPEYIELD: 15 pzas

YOGURT BREAD

SUB-RECIPE · NOOK · VOCO Surf SideDe La Mora Zumarán · Kitchen Support
INGREDIENTS
INGREDIENTQTYUNIT
QUICK PRE-FERMENT (SPONGE)
Strong bread flour200g
Warm water (~30°C)200g
Fresh yeast30g
FINAL DOUGH
Strong bread flour800g
Plain whole yogurt (unsweetened)400g
Water50g
Fine salt20g
Softened butter50g
Entire pre-ferment430g
3 × 550g dough pieces · ~3.5 hours total
PROCEDURE
1PRE-FERMENT ACTIVATION
Mix sponge ingredients until homogenous. Rest at room temperature in a warm area for 30–45 minutes until bubbly and doubled in volume.
2DIRECT MIXING
In the spiral mixer, add remaining flour, yogurt, water, and active pre-ferment. Mix on speed 1 (V1) for 3 minutes.
3GLUTEN DEVELOPMENT
Switch to speed 2 (V2), add salt, mix for 5 minutes. Incorporate softened butter and mix 2–3 additional minutes until an elastic gluten network forms. Target dough temperature: 25°C.
4BULK FERMENTATION
Cover and rest the dough at room temperature for 45 minutes.
5SCALING AND SHAPING
Divide into 550g portions. Round and shape immediately according to the desired mold or format.
6FINAL PROOFING
Transfer to proofing cabinet at 28°C / 75% RH for 45–60 minutes until pieces double in size.
7BAKING
Bake at 210°C with steam injection for the first 3 minutes. Reduce to 200°C and bake an additional 20–25 minutes until crust is firm and golden.

VOLCAN CHOCOLATE

SUB-RECIPE · NOOK · VOCO Surf SideDe La Mora Zumarán · Kitchen Support
INGREDIENTS
INGREDIENTQTYUNIT
INGREDIENTS
Semi-sweet chocolate250g
Unsalted butter200g
Whole eggs5pcs
Egg yolks3pcs
White granulated sugar120g
All-purpose flour70g
Fine salt1pinch
Butter + cocoa powderto coat molds
10 portions · Prep: 15 min + 2 h chilling
PROCEDURE
1MOLD PREPARATION
Grease 10 individual ramekins with butter and dust evenly with cocoa powder. Tap out any excess.
2MELTING THE CHOCOLATE
Melt chocolate and butter together in 30-second microwave intervals or over a double boiler until smooth and uniform. Allow to cool slightly before proceeding.
3EGG MIXTURE
In a large bowl, vigorously whisk whole eggs, yolks, and sugar until the mixture lightens in color and sugar is mostly dissolved.
4INTEGRATION
Pour the melted chocolate into the egg mixture and stir well to combine. Sift in flour and salt, folding gently just until no dry spots remain.
5PORTIONING AND RESTING
Fill molds to 3/4 capacity. Refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours. This resting period is essential to ensure the center remains liquid during baking.
6BAKING
Bake at 200°C for 9–11 minutes. Edges should be firm; center must show a slight dip and feel soft to the touch. Exact timing depends on oven and batter temperature. Unmold and serve immediately.

TARTA BASCA

SUB-RECIPE · NOOK · VOCO Surf SideDe La Mora Zumarán · Kitchen Support
INGREDIENTS
INGREDIENTQTYUNIT
INGREDIENTS (×2 BATCH)
Cream cheese21.16oz
Goat cheese14.11oz
Heavy cream (Lyncott or equivalent)14.11oz
White granulated sugar14.11oz
Whole eggs8pcs
Egg yolks4pcs
Lemon zest2pcs
1 mold · scale ×2 · 150g portions
PROCEDURE
1OVEN PREHEAT
Set oven to 220°C (428°F). Ensure the oven reaches full temperature before loading.
2MOLD PREPARATION
Butter the mold and line the interior with moistened parchment paper, allowing it to overhang the edges by at least 2 cm.
3BATTER PROCESSING
Combine all ingredients — cream cheese, goat cheese, heavy cream, sugar, eggs, yolks, and lemon zest — in a blender or food processor. Process until completely smooth, silky, and lump-free.
4BAKING
Pour the batter into the prepared mold and bake at 220°C for 15–18 minutes. The standard: top surface must be deeply caramelized with the center still visibly trembling when the pan is gently shaken.
5COOLING AND SETTING
Remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Transfer to refrigeration for a minimum of 4 hours to fully stabilize the creamy structure.
6PORTIONING AND SERVICE
Unmold and slice with a hot knife for clean cuts. Serve at room temperature.
